recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future patient-focused EOB implementation guides that need this privacy rule should profile out payment details other than date when a provider payee would expose confidential payment information; a core constraint should only be added after a new Financial Management work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-17976 was a Published FHIR-core ExplanationOfBenefit change request, resolved Not Persuasive with Modification, asking for a base constraint so that when the payee is not the subscriber only payment.type and payment.date would be permitted to maintain payment confidentiality. The accepted modification was to document how an implementation guide can include the restriction because EOB is also used for reporting where payment information may be required.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in historical EOB work. Commit 89bb47c31d84c7cc3fb753e5408806226f62d395 mentioned GF#17976 in broad spreadsheet/example changes, and commit 96ee4c7ff55abe91e3c9e496f4eda7609be542ba explicitly mentioned #17976 while adding the current EOB introduction note that patient-focused EOB profiles should exclude payment details other than date when the payee is the provider because those details would leak business confidential information.
additional_context: ExplanationOfBenefit is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to the FM work group. The current StructureDefinition still defines EOB payment details without a payee-dependent invariant, which is consistent with the final Jira modification: core EOB remains usable for reporting/payment scenarios, while implementation guides can profile patient-focused exchanges more tightly. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later issue-specific or work-group evidence reversing this conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. Adding a base invariant would contradict the final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution, and adding duplicative prose would not materially improve implementer understanding because the active narrative already gives the IG/profile guidance.
